question: How many defects were logged at each plant for low severity defects?
sql: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.quantity) AS defects FROM defect_logs d JOIN inspections i ON i.inspection_id = d.inspection_id JOIN production_runs r ON r.run_id = i.run_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = r.machine_id JOIN production_lines l ON l.line_id = m.line_id JOIN plants pl ON pl.plant_id = l.plant_id WHERE d.severity = 'low' GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY defects DESC;
